alsoKnownAs.name: Sahlab flour
alsoKnownAs.note: The Arabic name for the same tuber powder, used where the root itself rather than a starch substitute is meant.

forms.label: Ground orchid tuber
forms.sourceNote: FoodData Central carries no record for salep, the ground tuber of wild orchids, and none is claimed here rather than estimated. It matters less than it looks: a drink is thickened with only a small spoonful, and the bulk of what is measured, in both volume and nutrition, comes from the milk and sugar around it.
